content:
incident-bot: PAGE: paging alex.lewis (on-call) for HIGH: runtime errors increasing on inference-r1 (~service errors 5xx). Severity: P1. Link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1795001234

alex.lewis: on it. joining bridge now. can someone drop the initial error sample?

maria.chen: saw a spike ~ 07:12 UTC, error rate went from ~0.3% to 6% within 3m. attaching logs snippet below.

maria.chen: ```
2026-02-28T07:12:09Z inference-r1 worker=7 error="kv cache OOM" model=redwood-v2 seq_len=1024 trace_id=0x8f9d
2026-02-28T07:12:10Z inference-r1 worker=3 error="failed to allocate workspace" model=redwood-v2 seq_len=2048 trace_id=0x8fa2
```

devon: thanks. sounds like memory pressure on runtime nodes after a model rollout. any deploys around 07:10-07:12?

jamie.sre: I see a deployment of redwood-v2-quantized pushed at 07:09 by ci-bot. rolling back now to previous variant.

sre-lead: tagging product-ops and support-bot for customer impact assessment. product-ops, can you coordinate status page updates?

product-ops: on it. initial draft for status page below — please review / confirm impact window.

product-ops: ```
Status: Degraded 
Service: Text generation (inference-r1)
Impact: Some requests receive 5xx errors or timeouts, intermittent, starting ~07:12 UTC
Mitigation: Rollback of redwood-v2-quantized in progress; autoscaling and node restart in flight
Next update: 07:30 UTC
```

support-bot: Noted. I’ll prepare customer-facing FAQ for targeted accounts (EDU and finance customers flagged).

alex.lewis: rollback completed at 07:18 UTC. error rate back to baseline by 07:23. timeline so far:
- 07:09 deploy redwood-v2-quantized
- 07:12 error spike kv cache OOM / failed allocation
- 07:12-07:16 oncall triage + confirm reproducible
- 07:17 initiated rollback
- 07:18 rollback finished
- 07:23 error rate normalized

maria.chen: logs show evictions before OOMs; likely kernel change in quantized build affecting workspace allocation. grabbing kernel and runtime logs now.

devon: adding hypothesis: quantized variant changes memory layout for KV cache + new kernel path not respecting memory cap -> fragmentation -> OOM. Secondary hypothesis: autoscale suppressed due to deployment labeling mismatch.

jamie.sre: gathered node-level metrics. attaching summary: average GPU memory usage jumped 12% on nodes running quantized variant; per-process RSS spiked for runtime-worker.

sre-lead: actionable next steps (assign owners):
- [alex.lewis] collect artefacts for postmortem: full logs, rollout config, image hash, node metrics (due EOD)
- [maria.chen] reproduce in staging with quantized image and stress KV cache (priority: reproduce)
- [devon] run kernel diff between image builds, focus on allocator and workspace init code
- [jamie.sre] validate autoscaler labeling and rollout flags for Dedicated pools
- [product-ops] update status page and send stakeholder note once we have confirmed cause

alex.lewis: note — customer impact: 21 distinct customers experienced elevated error rates; 3 big accounts reported degraded UX. support-bot please escalate high-touch accounts.

support-bot: Escalation underway. P1 customer emails templated and queued.

product-ops: second status page update: added affected customers count and mitigation complete at 07:23 UTC. planning postmortem summary for 09:00 UTC.

maria.chen: repro attempt in staging: reproduced OOM when sequence length > 512 and kv-cache warm — looks pretty consistent. sending repro steps in a gist: https://gist.internal/repro/1795001234

devon: kernel diff shows change in `workspace_init()` in runtime C++ layer between builds: new alignment logic for quantized kernels. rolling a patch to revert alignment change for now.

jamie.sre: autoscaler labels were correct. no suppression — turns out the rollback completed faster than scale-up would have reacted. good to know.

sre-lead: communications plan for execs: short blurb + customer impact numbers + next steps (patch and time to fix)

product-ops: draft exec note below — please sign off.

product-ops: ```
Executive summary: On 2026-02-28 07:12 UTC, a rollout of a quantized model variant caused memory fragmentation in the inference runtime, producing elevated 5xx errors for some requests. Rollback completed at 07:18 UTC, and service normalized by 07:23 UTC. 21 customers experienced elevated errors; 3 reported noticeable degradation.
Planned next steps: revert alignment change and validate in staging (expected fix within 4h), full postmortem to follow.
```

alex.lewis: signed off. please also include mitigation: temporarily pinning quantized model to avoid automatic rollouts.

product-ops: done. status page final update posted at 07:35 UTC.

jamie.sre: follow-up item: add a canary gate for memory footprint delta before promoting quantized builds. filing ticket INF-4821.

maria.chen: will run extended stress tests on quantized path and report results in postmortem.

devon: patch built and validated in staging at 08:30 UTC. scheduling safe rollout with canary gate after validation window.

sre-lead: closing incident channel for live mitigation; maintain thread for RCA notes and artifacts. thanks everyone for quick coordination. :tada:

alex.lewis: adding final artifact links before close:
- rollout config: https://repo.internal/rollouts/1795001234
- logs bundle: https://logs.internal/bundles/1795001234
- kernel diff: https://code.internal/diff/1795001234

support-bot: customer follow-ups delivered. will attach response summaries to postmortem.

product-ops: scheduling postmortem at 09:00 UTC; invite: #eng, #sre, #product, #support.

on-participating-bot: Archival note: thread will be archived after postmortem.
